Shaped iteration 0168: a graph with one task, `scorer-stall-0168` (benchmark, default model, medium effort, 40 min, 30 turns, starts from main, #747 report exported).

Why: two attempts to finish the #739 zero-execution fix stalled for tool reasons, not because of the task content. These were #743 (inline one-liners, then Bash disabled) and #747. In #747, `python3 -I -c print(1)` and a bare-print script worked. A script that only loaded score.py from task/739 through importlib never returned ([#747 report](.session/history/sessions/747/acb37f010f907e9d2a246f9c313374d15ecd107a6615661405130f7899de343a.md)). Iteration 0167's own rule says not to order the full finish a third time, so this iteration only measures the stall and fixes nothing.

The task makes copies of the task/739 and HEAD versions of score.py with `git show`. It scans both for code that can block when the module loads. It then runs each copy under a faulthandler guard with stdin set to devnull: first the import, then `generate()`. It never calls `main()`.

Expected gain: `benchmark/challenges/scorer-stall-0168.md` with the sections `## Static scan`, `## Probe results` and `## Cause`. The Verification command checks those headings.

`.session/tasks.json` passed the direct Python check for JSON and headings (exit 0). `journal/working-memory.md` is rewritten with all four sections. Nothing was executed in this shaper session: no task, product, benchmark, evaluator or native code. no_progress is now 3, so the Policymaker trigger may fire.

## What next
- If `## Cause` names a method that works, order the finish with `start_branch: task/739` using that method. Put its review, `blocked_by` the finish, in the same graph.
- If the cause is `not found`, or the probe stalls too, put a suggestion about runner Bash stalls in `.session/suggestions.json`. Then switch to read-only design work: constant-export detection, or independent confirmation of the XML key.
- Do not order the full finish again before the stall has been measured.
